full_judgment: 2. Short facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that, the opposite party Chittagong Steel Mills Limited as plaintiff instituted Money Suit No. 35 of 1989, renumbered as Money Suit No. 31 of 1990, before the Subordinate Judge and 2nd Court of Artha Rin Adalat Chittagong against the present petitioner and Pubali Bank Limited praying for a decree for recovery of Taka 6,36,00,583,86 from the defendant-petitioner along with other reliefs. This suit was filed on 25-4-1990. The claim of flat plaintiff is based on 22 bank guarantees furnished by the petitioner Bank in favour of opposite party, Chittagong Steel Mills Limited on behalf of 13 dealers for lifting of CI sheets weighing 2400 tonnes worth about taka one crore.
